news.headline: NeurAxis to Host Second Quarter 2026 Results and Business Update Call on August 11
news.summary: NeurAxis confirmed it will report Q2 2026 financial results (quarter ended June 30, 2026) before market open on Tuesday, August 11, 2026, followed by a conference call at 9:00am ET to review results and provide a business update. This locks in the previously-estimated mid-August reporting date.

news.headline: NeurAxis Declares Q2 Stock Dividend on Series B Preferred Stock
news.summary: NeurAxis's board authorized a Q2 2026 stock dividend on its Series B Preferred Stock, to be paid entirely in common shares (roughly 80,463 new shares, based on accrued dividends divided by $2.38) rather than cash. The dividend was payable July 29, 2026 to Series B holders of record as of July 21, 2026, conserving cash but modestly diluting common shareholders.

news.headline: NeurAxis Stockholders Approve Director Elections and Equity Plan Expansion at 2026 Annual Meeting
news.summary: At its June 10, 2026 annual meeting, NeurAxis stockholders elected six director nominees and approved expanding the 2022 Omnibus Incentive Plan's authorized share pool from 1,482,152 to 3,400,000 shares along with a new 2025 Employee Stock Purchase Plan. Stockholders also ratified Rosenberg Rich Baker Berman, P.A. as the company's auditor.

news.headline: NeurAxis Reports Record First Quarter 2026 Financial Results Driven by 80% Year-Over-Year Revenue Growth
news.summary: NeurAxis posted record Q1 2026 revenue of about $1.6 million, up 80% year over year, its seventh consecutive quarter of double-digit growth, with gross margin expanding roughly 200 basis points to 86.4% following the new Category I CPT reimbursement code for PENFS. Operating and net losses improved about 24% and 23% respectively, and management reiterated a target of reducing quarterly cash burn to $1 million or less through the rest of 2026.

news.headline: NeurAxis Expands Payer Coverage with Four New Medical Policies
news.summary: NeurAxis announced four additional health insurers adopted medical policies covering its PENFS/IB-Stim therapy, adding roughly 1.25 million newly covered lives across West Virginia, New Hampshire, South Carolina, Virginia and Florida. This continued the post-CPT-code pattern of incremental reimbursement wins expanding the device's addressable, insured patient base.

news.headline: NeurAxis CEO and CFO Buy Shares in Open-Market Purchases
news.summary: CEO Brian Carrico and CFO Timothy Henrichs each bought NeurAxis common shares on the open market on April 1, 2026 at $1.96 per share, alongside a smaller purchase by another executive at the same price. The same-day, same-price cluster of insider buys was read by some investors as a signal of management confidence in the stock.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings report and business update call
catalysts.detail: NeurAxis will report summarized Q2 2026 financial results (quarter ended June 30, 2026) before market open on Tuesday, August 11, 2026, with a conference call at 9:00am ET; investors will watch whether the reimbursement-driven revenue ramp seen in Q1 2026 (+80% YoY) continued into Q2 and whether management's quarterly cash-burn reduction target is on track.

catalysts.label: Further payer/insurer coverage expansion
catalysts.detail: Following the AMA Category I CPT code for PENFS taking effect January 1, 2026 and additional insurer policy wins covering roughly 1.25 million lives announced in April 2026, NeurAxis has a pattern of periodically announcing new medical policy coverage decisions that could continue to expand its reimbursed addressable market.

catalysts.label: VA hospital system commercial rollout
catalysts.detail: NeurAxis secured a Federal Supply Schedule contract with the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs and began its VA commercial push in early 2026; broader adoption across the VA's roughly 180 hospitals depends on physician education and hospital value-analysis committee approvals rather than insurer sign-off, and could act as an incremental revenue driver if uptake accelerates.

pulse: NeurAxis remained largely quiet on the news front through June and July 2026 aside from routine corporate actions: stockholders approved director elections and an expanded equity incentive plan at the June 10 annual meeting, a Q2 stock dividend on Series B Preferred shares settled July 29, and on July 28 the company formally confirmed Q2 2026 results will be released August 11 with a 9am ET call. This follows a strong spring in which Q1 2026 revenue hit a record $1.6M (+80% YoY) on the back of the new AMA Category I CPT reimbursement code and roughly 1.25 million newly covered lives from insurer wins announced in April, alongside open-market insider buying by the CEO and CFO. The upcoming August 11 print is the key near-term catalyst to confirm whether that reimbursement-driven growth and margin trajectory continued into Q2.
